commands.author: qingminglong

target.title: fix(computer): reject malformed numeric input before node actions
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users invoking the `computer` tool through gateway-visible tool surfaces could provide malformed numeric values and have them coerced into desktop actions instead of rejected when issuing scroll, hold-key, or wait actions.

## Why This Change Was Made

The computer tool now uses the existing strict numeric readers at the execution boundary for `scrollAmount` and `duration`, matching the owner-local guard pattern used by adjacent node-control numeric inputs. Valid defaults and the existing scroll clamp behavior stay intact; malformed present values fail before any node command or follow-up screenshot is invoked.

## User Impact

Malformed desktop-control numeric inputs now fail early with actionable validation errors, so invalid raw tool invocations cannot turn booleans, fractional scroll ticks, or nonnumeric durations into unintended computer-control actions.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: malformed `computer` numeric inputs are rejected at the real tool execution boundary before any `node.invoke` dispatch, while valid scroll input still reaches `computer.act` and keeps the existing 100-tick clamp.
- Current head: `6c39afe6275c9378410dff43163d1d4efa92bfc1`.
- Runtime seam proof: a one-off loopback GatewayClient transcript exercised `createComputerTool()` through the real `callGatewayTool` WebSocket path against a redacted computer-capable node stub that recorded `node.list` and `node.invoke` calls.

```text
PASS malformed scrollAmount: error="scrollAmount must be a positive integer" node.invoke.delta=0
PASS malformed hold_key duration: error="duration must be >0 and <=10 seconds for hold_key" node.invoke.delta=0
PASS malformed wait duration: error="duration must be 0-100 seconds for wait" node.invoke.delta=0
PASS valid scroll dispatch: commands=computer.act,screen.snapshot scrollAmount=100
SUMMARY node.list.calls=4 node.invoke.calls=2
```

- Focused regression proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/computer-tool.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 65 tests passing at the same head.
- Branch diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Observed result: malformed `scrollAmount`, `hold_key` duration, and `wait` duration stop after node resolution with zero `node.invoke` calls; a valid oversized scroll reaches the node command path and is clamped to `scrollAmount=100` before the follow-up screenshot.
